reason: French marigold roots release thiophenes, which suppress root-knot nematodes. This works as a solid stand grown for a season before the tomatoes, not as a few plants dotted along a border.
source: Virginia Cooperative Extension SPES-620, "Companion Planting in Gardening"

reason: A Blue Hubbard perimeter draws squash bugs, squash vine borer and cucumber beetles off the main planting. Sow the trap row a fortnight early so it is the bigger plant when they arrive.
source: Trap cropping review, Insects 2018 9(4):128 (doi:10.3390/insects9040128)
